q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA's guidance for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027 (which ended approximately in late July 2026) was released on May 20, 2026, alongside its Q1 FY2027 results. The company projected revenue to be $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/). This figure is notably above the average quarterly revenue estimate of $86.84 billion from LSEG [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html).

NVIDIA explicitly stated that this outlook does not assume any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/). Gross margins for Q2 FY2027 are expected to be 74.9% (GAAP) and 75.0% (non-GAAP), plus or minus 50 basis points. Operating expenses are anticipated to be approximately $8.5 billion (GAAP) and $8.3 billion (non-GAAP) [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm). Any Data Center sales to China that clear would represent upside to the $91 billion guidance [news.ifyouspent.com](https://news.ifyouspent.com/en/news/nvidia-earnings-what-to-watch-august-2026).
